    DOGE vs PEPE: what the numbers show

    Dogecoin's market cap of about $9.87B is 6.5 times Pepe's ($1.52B); they rank #11 and #30 of the 114 coins tracked here. Over the past year Dogecoin fell 60.5% and Pepe fell 17.5%, a gap of 43.0 percentage points in Pepe's favour. Pepe was the more volatile of the two over the last 30 days (106.1% annualized against 65%). Within the year, Dogecoin's largest fall between daily closes was 64.9% and Pepe's was 67.5%. On November 22, 2026 Dogecoin was 64.2% below its 52-week high and Pepe 52.6% below its own. In 6 of the last 12 complete months, Dogecoin did better than Pepe. Measured against Bitcoin's daily moves over 90 days, Dogecoin had a correlation of 0.86 and Pepe 0.62.
